name: clichilds
description: 多 CLI 协同工作台（Windows 桌面端）

scripts.dist: set "ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/" && set "ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/" && node scripts/bump-version.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && node scripts/desktop-shortcut.mjs
scripts.dist:dir: set "ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/" && set "ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/" && node scripts/bump-version.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
